name: 3C 403 (Webb)
blurb: 3C 403, an X-shaped radio galaxy, seen by Webb.
label: 3c403-webb
story: Jets of plasma stream from the active core of this galaxy, and in radio light its lobes splay outward into a winged, X-like shape. Astronomers return to its jet again and again to track how that plasma moves.

claims.text: 3C 403 is an X-shaped FR II radio galaxy
Its radio morphology is called winged or X-shaped
3C 403 has an optical jet monitored to track plasma motion; this Webb program is a new epoch of that monitoring
